reviews.t: Impossible to apply without bruising your armpits !
reviews.x: I have been using Primal pit paste  ( the jar version )for couple of months now and i was very happy with it. My only concern was that i had to apply it with a spatula . Thats why i decided to order this stick. BIG mistake ...the product is so hard to apply that every time a literally bruised my armpits while doing it. How come the jar version is so soft and the stick version is like frozen sand. After 2 attempts my armpits are already red and hurting !

reviews.t: Best deodorant I've ever tried (and I've tried a LOT
reviews.x: Best deodorant I've ever tried (and I've tried  a LOT!). I prefer the smell of the lavender version, but the orange is quite a nice scent as well. Seriously worth the money if you're a sweaty, smelly gal like me who doesn't want aluminum on her pits!

reviews.t: Stops odor but ruined my clothes and literally melted during wear.
reviews.x: This product smells wonderful and seem to stop body odor, but both it & the lavender scent are ruining the underarm areas of my shirts, with the added grossness of the product seeming to melt and run down my arms. Ick. Super disappointing, even using Persil detergent and BIZ enzymes along with a prewash doesn't budge them. Serious disappointment.

the best natural deodorant. Really. I was outsmelling my husband and this did the trick, after trying all the alternatives. This scent seems to work better than the others by the same company - not sure why there should be a difference, but there is.

reviews.t: Best Natural Deoderant on the Market.
reviews.x: This deoderant actually works, even when working out. It's probably the most effective brand I've used when it comes to all natural ingredients (no aluminum). The only downside (rated it a 4 star) was its sticky feel. The stick does not glide on. Make sure to use it sparingly. It is better than the other product where you have to use your finger to apply it (yet it has a nicer texture).
Very sticky feeling after application. It did work for deodorizing, but, the feeling of it on my skin was very sticky, and felt very uncomfortable.

I have tried many deodorants over the years. My #1's that I have used since high school is Soft N Dry/Lady Speed Stick/Dove. These have all been interchanged through the years and the thing they all have in common is they all work well for me and have Aluminum as the #1 ingredient.  After having my gastric sleeve surgery I have been more diligent to get healthy. I have been into essential oils for about 15 years and used them for various things over that time but now I make my own skin care prod

reviews.t: An all natural deodorant that works & lasts! Can be irritating.
reviews.x: I’ve been in search of an all natural deodorant that actually works and I have finally found it!! I’ve tried so many to have them stop working after 2 hrs & I’m not a super sweaty person. I would love this product even more & give 5 stars but I can’t because it can be a little irritating but it works well so I can deal. (Pretty sure it’s the baking soda) I also like that it doesn’t get all tacked on when I try to clean my armpits in the shower like most other deodorants do.

Smells good and as far as I can tell does help with body odor but the application is not convenient. It crumbles all over your underarms and you have to then dab it and wipe the crumbs off. I have tried warming it shorter, longer and it doesn't seem to matter. Would be nice if they could formulate it so you can actually use it like a regular deodorant and slide it on without worrying it will leave crumbs all over.

I really love this deodorant, however I find it rather "hard", as in maybe my house is too cold for it to go on smoothly??? I also own the jar primal pit paste which is softer and easier to apply, but I bought these for my teenagers thinking they'd prefer the stick...not sure enough comes out during application though...

The ONLY “natural” deodorant that actually works! My husband and I have tried many brands over the last 15 years and this one is by far the best. Saw themon Shark Tank and happened to find it at a small local health store. We always buy it now!
This works better than any natural deodorant I’ve ever tried.

reviews.t: I like stick better than a paste because it's creamier and ...
reviews.x: I have tried many natural deodorants by now and I have to say that this one is the most effective and most natural I have used. I like stick better than a paste because it's creamier and moisturizes skin better with oils, which I found very important because it has baking soda, so I feel like oils give an extra protection to my skin. I have sensitive skin but I had no bad reaction to this deo as some people did. It's important to note that any deodorant shouldn't be applied right after shaving.

I have tried this Primal Pit Paste for the paste 3 weeks. At first my armpits got very red and swollen. Reading online about the “detox” I suffered through.  Once the redness and swelling went away my armpits started to darken and itch. My skin started to feel leathery, tough and breakout. At 3 weeks I’ve decided I can not continue with this misery.  After the first week my natural body odor was different, in a good way. Even my husband notcied I wasn’t smelling like ammonia like I was with your

reviews.t: Finally found something to replace Secret
reviews.x: I've been using the same Secret deodorant for about a decade. When I decided to clean up my diet and personal habits for health reasons, deodorant was on my detox list. This is the best deodorant I've found that keeps the body odor under control without all of the chemicals I'm trying to avoid. The texture takes some getting used to (it sort of smears on) and I definitely need another solution for tank tops because it's too visible. Another pro is that it is gentle with my clothes too...no stain

Primal Pit Paste is the best natural deodorant I have tried.  The ingredients don't even make sense to me as something that would help, but they work!  I have to reapply it every day, but it works all day.

After two uses, I had a rash under my arms which I never have had with regular antiperspirants! I had thought all natural was the way to go but you never know what might irritate your skin. Buyer beware!

This is one of the first pit paste I’ve ever used before and it’s GREAT! It truly works and just a little goes along way. It’s not sticky either. I’ve used it once in the morning for an all day test in triple digit weather and it keeps you fresh. It doesn’t mask the order because there is NO ODOR. I love it! I’m so excited since I’ve started using this product my pits have not darkened. I’ve heard that one of the causes of this is the aluminum in regular deodorants. I totally recommend this prod

reviews.t: Looong lasting both by all day long and 4 months roll on lasted. Seems pricey but it’s not in comparison
reviews.x: WoW ........not only does this work for myself it works for my husband. We both have no odor issues The orange I can barely smell so it’s not distracting It’s not all EZ glide on but it’s not hard. Use just a little and it works well . No complaints. Price is high BUT when I saw when I bought it 4 months ago and we are just close ( 2-3weeks) to running out ........... that’s quite a long time ! And I don’t have to use much nor does my husband. Works all day til next AM Really liking this deodora

The best natural deodorant I've found and love the stick version. Seems to hold up well and keep the stink away, but it allows you to sweat as it's not an antiperspirant. This is normally a good thing except for when you're at work or in a social situation where you don't want to sweat. If I know I'm going to be in an environment where I get anxiety or tend to stress, I will use an antiperspirant just for that day. Otherwise, this is my go to for regular work days, etc. Will continue to buy.

reviews.t: Works great - May have had one bad batch
reviews.x: Great deodorant that stands up to tough workouts. I love the orange scent. -1 star for consistency, as the last shipment I received had a slightly funny odor, like old or possibly rancid oil...However I’m chalking it up as a one-off, because I have never had that issue in the past.

I have been buying the pit paste in the jar and really like it!  Having trouble finding the orange scent, so I decided to buy the stick formula.  Not to be redundant but the stick formula is very sticky and unpleasant to use.  May have to change scent and go back to the jar!

reviews.t: Great till reaction, had to ditch it
reviews.x: I don't know if it's the product's fault or just a personal allergy thing but after a few months I developed lumps under my skin.  They went away after discontinuing for a week, then came right back after resuming.  Too bad because I loved the stuff before that reaction

claims.text: Reviewers widely report that it actually works and is the most effective natural deodorant they've tried.
Several reviewers find the stick hard and difficult to apply, with some reporting crumbling or bruising.
Some reviewers describe a sticky or uncomfortable feel after application.
A few reviewers report the product ruining clothes or causing irritation.
